name: The Cottage in the Woods
source:
Marsha is an elderly witch, and the owner of a magical cottage deep in the woods. 

When she dies suddenly, two people who plan to clean out the house discover that she shared the cottage with a cheerful spirit who is unable to leave the property. 

Play as a friendly spirit who has been stuck in this cottage for a while. Now more lonely than ever, she fears spending eternity alone and invisible. 

 Fall in love as you try to free yourself from this mysterious cottage. 

[From [url=https://star-sphagnum.itch.io/the-cottage-in-the-woods]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
年迈的女巫玛莎在幽深林间拥有一座充满魔力的小屋。

当她骤然离世后，两名打算前来清理遗物的人意外发现，老人生前竟一直与一位无法离开这片宅地的开朗幽灵同住屋檐下。

你将扮演这位受困于小屋中已有些时日的友善幽灵。如今比以往任何时候都更加孤单的她，深怕自己将在无人得见的寂寞中度过漫漫永恒。

在努力设法挣脱这座神秘小屋束缚的旅途中，邂逅一段动人的恋情吧。

[摘自[url=https://star-sphagnum.itch.io/the-cottage-in-the-woods]itch.io[/url]]
